window-1.title: Poolsuite FM
window-1.blurb: It's an entire sun-bleached 90s computer desktop that plays endless summer radio — the kind of committed-to-the-bit web world you'll want to steal interface ideas from while it scores your next side quest.

window-2.title: Web Curios
window-2.blurb: It's one guy, every week, dragging back armfuls of the weirdest and most wonderful things on the internet with running commentary that's funnier than it has any right to be — pure side-quest fuel for you.

window-3.title: Classic Vietnamese Plum Soda (Soda Xí Muội)
window-3.blurb: Salty-sour preserved plum drowned in fizz over cracked ice — it's the nostalgic, slightly feral cousin of every polite floral mocktail, and you get to eat the plum at the end like a prize.

window-4.title: Sight Unseen: Inside a Vintage-Filled NYC Home

window-5.title: Cookboys, I12 Katong
window-5.blurb: It's a whole 1970s Hainanese cookboy universe built out in vintage signboards and old shopfronts — basically a persona shoot you can order kopi in, and I need you to photograph the signage before anyone else does.
